requirements.title: LEADZ I argument is integer
requirements.definition: I shall be of type integer.

pending.LEADZ-I-integer: Positive source plan calls LEADZ with integer expressions including 0, 1, NOT(0), and IBSET(0,BIT_SIZE(0)-1); source-control mutation changes I to logical and claims no diagnostic facet.

requirements.title: LEADZ counts leading zero bits in the 16.3 integer bit model
requirements.definition: For all-zero bits LEADZ returns BIT_SIZE(I); otherwise it returns BIT_SIZE(I)-1-k, where k is the position of the leftmost 1 bit in I using the 16.3 bit model.

pending.LEADZ-all-zero-bits: Use result sentinel -777, assert LEADZ(0)==BIT_SIZE(0), and pair with LEADZ(1) so a constant zero result cannot pass.
pending.LEADZ-one-low-bit-count: Assert LEADZ(1)==BIT_SIZE(1)-1 and mutate the intrinsic to TRAILZ so the low-bit discriminator fails.
pending.LEADZ-leftmost-one-count-zero: Pass IBSET(0,BIT_SIZE(0)-1) directly to LEADZ and assert result zero; observe only the bit-count result, not the numeric value of the leftmost-bit integer.
pending.LEADZ-all-one-bits: Pass NOT(0) directly to LEADZ and assert result zero because no leading zero bit remains; mutate NOT(0) to 0 so the all-one bit context is load-bearing.

Every unit hash-verified by an independent reviewer across two rounds; LCOBOUND runtime facets are out of scope; LEN covers deferred-length allocated and associated characters; LGE and LGT use pairs whose ASCII order differs from plausible native orders.
